counting_rule: 2026-10-05 (EM, QA-R1-03): a lane's units count as implemented when its code is committed, review round 1 has been held, and that story's own tests for the lane are green in the latest local run (backend: 2026-10-05 EM re-run at 094a344: cd backend && env -u APP_ENV uv run pytest -q (dev Postgres + object store) -> 18 failed, 1020 passed, 16 skipped, 9 errors; every red test is a Pending test-change row or an open blocker (smoke.md S-04, S-05, S-07, S-08); web: 2026-10-05 EM re-run at 094a344: cd web && pnpm exec vitest run -> 30 files, 244 passed; browser: smoke.md §3 (tree 6ba9b28): Playwright chromium over https -> 38 passed, 6 failed, 6 skipped). A lane with any of its own tests red locally counts 0 until the fix or the test-change decision lands. WebKit-only CI failures stay in 'open' and block DoD, not 'implemented'. dod_done_units stay 0: ci-gate is red (blockers.md) and external evidence is open.
